snippet.title: Upin & Ipin Universe is coming this July - Wishlist Today!
snippet.description:
We're counting down to the official launch of Upin & Ipin Universe on July 17th! Get ready for the highly anticipated open-world adventure game inspired by Southeast Asia’s beloved Upin & Ipin series.

Wishlist/preorder today on PlayStation 4 and 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC on Steam and Epic Game Store.

#upinipingame #lescopaque #streamlinestudios #streamlinemediagroup
